durables.statement: The team has decided to sunset the legacy billing API by Q3 2026.
Flaky CI on the payments suite is a recurring release blocker.
The organization has hired a second Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to handle the on-call rotation, suggesting a growth in the team or an increased focus on operational reliability.
The decision to standardize on Postgres for new services was reversed in favor of DynamoDB after load testing.
